headline: Firebase SDK is CRASHING ALL iOS Apps since today morning
summary: A critical bug in Google's Firebase SDK is causing widespread crashes across all iOS applications that integrate it. Users are reporting total app failures across various popular services.
details: Google's Firebase SDK has been identified as the cause of widespread crashes affecting numerous iOS applications since this morning. Reports indicate that apps integrating the SDK are experiencing total failures for all user sessions.

Developers on Hacker News and other platforms are confirming the issue, with one user reporting "2.7K crashes in last 25 min" for their app. The incident highlights potential vulnerabilities in relying on third-party SDKs for core app functionality.

The unexpected outage has led to significant disruption for both app developers and end-users. Many are expressing concern over the impact, especially given Google's reputation for high engineering standards.
The exact root cause of the crash is not yet officially confirmed by Google. Developers are awaiting a fix or workaround to restore stability to their affected iOS applications.
